welcome:
Welcome to the Terraform CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated AWS infrastructure project.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, initialise the Terraform working directory to download providers and modules.
Validate the configuration files for syntax errors before planning.
Run a plan to preview what resources Terraform will create.
Save the plan to a file so you can apply exactly what was reviewed.
Apply the saved plan to create the infrastructure.
List all resources now tracked in state to confirm creation.
Inspect the VPC resource details in state.
View the outputs to get the VPC ID and subnet CIDRs.
Someone changed a security group manually in the AWS console. Run a plan to detect drift.
The plan shows drift. List all resources in state to understand what we manage.
A new S3 bucket was created outside Terraform. Import it into state.
Inspect the imported bucket in state to verify its attributes.
The web instance needs to be replaced due to a corrupted root volume. Taint it.
Run a plan to confirm the tainted instance will be destroyed and recreated.
Apply the changes to replace the tainted instance and reconcile drift.
Verify the final state by listing all managed resources.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  terraform init                 — Initialise working directory, download providers
  terraform plan                 — Preview changes (create/update/destroy)
  terraform apply                — Apply changes to infrastructure
  terraform destroy              — Destroy all managed infrastructure
  terraform state [subcommand]   — Inspect and manage state
  terraform import               — Import existing resource into state
  terraform workspace            — Manage workspaces
  terraform output               — Show output values
  terraform show                 — Show current state or a plan file
  terraform validate             — Check configuration syntax
  terraform fmt                  — Reformat configuration files
  terraform graph                — Generate a resource dependency graph
  terraform taint                — Mark resource for replacement
  terraform untaint              — Remove taint from a resource
  terraform console              — Interactive expression evaluator
  terraform providers            — Show required providers
  terraform version              — Show Terraform version
  terraform force-unlock         — Release a stuck state lock

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
